characters.name: Amudhan
characters.description: The central protagonist of Amudhapuranam whose life journey, deep emotional bonds, and fateful encounters drive the narrative.

characters.name: Vasu
characters.description: Amudhan's loyal childhood best friend and confidant who stands by him through every personal and emotional milestone.

characters.name: Ezhilan
characters.description: An ambitious pilot aspirant with a high sense of duty, honor, and courage whose path unexpectedly rescues and redirects Amudhan's life.

characters.name: Raghavi
characters.description: Ezhilan's supportive romantic partner who provides emotional strength and stability during critical turning points.

characters.name: Jeyanthi
characters.description: Vasu's sister, loved like family by Amudhan as well, serving as a bright, caring pillar within their close-knit circle.

characters.name: Valli
characters.description: Amudhan's initial emotional connection and first crush—a neighbor and close friend of Jeyanthi who shaped his youth.

characters.name: Pallavi
characters.description: Classmate of Amudhan and Vasu, whose charming presence sparks romantic feelings in Vasu and creates engaging group dynamics.

characters.name: Vennila
characters.description: Amudhan's first major romantic relationship—a deeply affection-filled and transformative chapter of his early adulthood.

characters.name: Sevvandhi
characters.description: Amudhan's loving mother, offering unconditional warmth, wisdom, and traditional care to anchor the family.

characters.name: Sivanaindhaan
characters.description: Amudhan's steadfast and hardworking father, acting as the quiet strength, moral pillar, and provider for the household.

characters.name: Kayal
characters.description: Amudhan's beloved younger sister, whose gentle presence and early loss.
